home.impactTitle: What do we mean by impact?
home.impactText: Impact is the measurable positive change in the lives of beneficiaries or the community caused by the project, evidenced by indicators with a baseline, a target and a clear data source. Impact is not an intention or a slogan — it is a result that is measured, tracked and verified.
impactPoints: Balance of financial and social return

about.title: About the Saudi Council for Impact Investors
about.lead: A body uniting impact investors in the Kingdom around one vision: directing capital toward measurable solutions to real social challenges.
about.visionText: Impact investing becomes a primary choice for private capital in the Kingdom, contributing to Vision 2030 targets in quality of life and nonprofit-sector growth.
about.missionText: Build a trusted ecosystem connecting investors with high-impact projects through clear evaluation criteria, transparent governance and impact-tracking tools.
goalsList: Increase capital directed to social projects
Raise the investment readiness of social projects
Unify the language of impact measurement
Build a professional network of impact investors
about.governanceText: The Council comprises a general assembly, a board, specialised committees (membership, evaluation, matching, impact) and an advisory committee. Details will be published once approved.

impactInvesting.title: What is impact investing?
impactInvesting.lead: Investment made with the intention to generate positive, measurable social or environmental impact alongside a financial return.
impactInvesting.definitionText: Impact investing directs capital to projects and organisations that create positive change in society or the environment, with an explicit commitment to measure and report that change, and a financial return ranging from capital preservation to market rate depending on the opportunity.

intent.title: Intentionality
intent.text: A clear, stated intent to create positive impact, not incidental impact.

evidence.title: Evidence & data
evidence.text: Investment design grounded in evidence about the problem and the solution.

management.title: Impact management
management.text: Tracking indicators and managing social performance as rigorously as financials.

contribution.title: Contribution to the sector
contribution.text: Sharing lessons and practices to grow impact investing.

impactInvesting.impactDefText: Impact is the ultimate change in beneficiaries' lives, measured by indicators that have a definition, unit, baseline, target, data source and measurement frequency.
impactInvesting.networksText: The platform's methodology aligns with widely used global impact-investing practices, adapted to the Saudi context.

privacy.p: Account data (name, email, mobile), investment or project profile data, and technical usage data. Data is classified by sensitivity: public, internal, confidential, sensitive personal.
Membership management, project evaluation, matching and connection, communication, and regulatory compliance. Investment-range data is used only for matching and aggregated reports.
Investor identity is shared with a project owner only after dual consent. We never sell data or share it with third parties for marketing.
Data is kept for defined periods (rejected and withdrawn: 365 days; inactive accounts: 730 days) then anonymised. You may request access, rectification or erasure.
Data is hosted inside the Kingdom, documents are encrypted and every access is logged.

terms.p: The platform is a connection and information tool; it collects no funds, holds none, issues no securities and gives no investment advice.
Membership is subject to Council review and may be suspended on breach of terms.
Declare data accuracy, disclose disputes and prior funding, and approve the teaser before publication.
Confidentiality of full files, no off-platform contact before connection, and compliance with the NDA.
Any investment agreement is concluded directly between the parties; the Council is not a party unless stated otherwise.

disclaimer.p: Information is provided by project owners and reviewed for form only; it is not a recommendation or a guarantee of accuracy.
The investor is responsible for due diligence and decisions. The Council is not liable for losses from any investment decision.
The platform performs no activity requiring a licence from the Capital Market Authority or the Saudi Central Bank.
